concerns.text: FR-011 mandates a sensitivity analysis using an 'independent ground-truth re-labeling protocol' to validate label noise impact. Tasks T036-T036b only implement downloading a secondary dataset (OWASP Benchmark) and re-calculating metrics. There is no task to perform the 're-labeling' or 'noise injection' mechanism required by the spec to validate the impact of noise, leaving the FR-011 requirement unfulfilled.

FR-004 requires embedding similarity to be computed against 'known vulnerable patterns' derived from an 'external, fixed reference set' to ensure independence. Tasks T019a-T019c implement downloading the NVD CVE feed dynamically. This creates a variable reference set dependent on the download date, violating the 'fixed' requirement for reproducibility (Constitution I). No task exists to freeze or snapshot this reference set.

FR-006 requires fitting a Logistic Regression model using the 'full set' of structural, semantic, and embedding features. Task T030-Impl explicitly states it will 'exclude embedding_similarity_score' from the model. This contradicts the requirement to use the full set of features, leaving the FR-006 requirement unfulfilled as specified.

The Spec Edge Cases require handling code snippets larger than the context window by truncating and recording the event. Task T057-Impl implements this logic but is placed in Phase 9 (Polish) with no dependency on the core inference task T013-Impl. If T013 runs before T057, the pipeline will crash on large snippets, violating the robustness requirement defined in the spec.
Task T010a-Impl (VulDeePecker Downloader) contains a placeholder: 'Fallback URL: .'. The URL is missing, making the task unexecutable as written. This is a writing defect in the task definition.
Task T036-Impl (Download Secondary Ground-Truth Subset) contains a placeholder: 'Fetch the OWASP Benchmark dataset (e.g., ,'. The URL is missing, making the task unexecutable as written.
